lines.text: Three lines of Java. Waits, screenshots and a report included.
In plain Selenium, the same test needs an explicit wait, a screenshot helper, report wiring, and a separate client for API calls.
Every team writes that plumbing, and every copy drifts.
Measured on the same test, that is 44 lines in plain Selenium, and 17 with SHAFT.
lines.say: Measured on the same test, that is forty four lines in plain Selenium, and seventeen with Shaft.

lines.text: SHAFT puts every surface behind one entry point.
SHAFT.GUI.WebDriver drives browsers and Appium apps. SHAFT.API wraps REST Assured. SHAFT.DB and SHAFT.CLI cover databases and terminals.
lines.say: Shaft dot G U I dot web driver drives browsers and Appy-um apps. Shaft dot API wraps rest assured. Shaft dot D B and Shaft dot C-L-I cover databases and terminals.

lines.text: Test data comes from JSON, Excel, CSV or YAML files, and every check uses the same assertThat style.
lines.say: Test data comes from JSON, Excel, CSV or YAML files, and every check uses the same assert that style.

lines.text: SHAFT handles timing for you.
Every element action retries until the element is ready, up to a timeout you configure.
After navigation, it waits for the page to go quiet: 300 milliseconds without changes, by default.
lines.say: After navigation, it waits for the page to go quiet: three hundred milliseconds without changes, by default.

lines.text: For business states, like an order status turning complete, you wait on that condition explicitly.
Retries are opt-in and bounded, and locators can target accessible roles and visible text.
Every action becomes an Allure step. Failures get screenshots by default, and validation points can get them too.
When a test fails, SHAFT attaches a diagnostics bundle and a trace with the DOM, network and console evidence it collected.
So the report explains the failure, not just the stack trace.
Where tests run is configuration, not code.
Change the execution address, and the same class runs locally, in Docker, on a Selenium Grid, or on BrowserStack and LambdaTest.
Cross browser mode can run one class on Chrome, Firefox and Safari in parallel with Docker.
Use TestNG, JUnit or Cucumber, and switch the browser backend to Playwright without rewriting your SHAFT steps.
Already have a Selenium suite? Run the upgrader.
It compiles your project first, adds the SHAFT bill of materials and engine, and keeps your existing tests as they are.
If the build fails afterwards, every touched file is restored, byte for byte.
When you are ready, session and full modes rewrite Selenium code inside the same safe transaction.
The agentic tools are optional, and they work without an AI provider.
Capture records a flow and generates compiling test code. Doctor diagnoses failed runs offline. Heal recovers changed locators and explains every choice.
The same tools reach IntelliJ through a plugin, and any agent through MCP.
lines.say: The same tools reach Intelli J through a plugin, and any agent through M C P.

lines.text: SHAFT is MIT licensed and built in public since 2018, with 216 releases.
lines.say: Shaft is M I T licensed and built in public since twenty eighteen, with two hundred and sixteen releases.
